Pineapple Sea Moss

Waddat Pineapple Sea Moss blends tropical pineapple sweetness with nutrient-rich sea moss, creating a smooth, refreshing Jamaican-inspired drink.

Request PricingTrade Brochure

DETAILS

Waddat Pineapple Sea Moss combines sweet tropical pineapple, mineral-rich sea moss, lemon, and honey in a smooth, refreshing 330ml drink. Packed with island flavour and natural sea moss goodness. Serve chilled for best taste.

INGREDIENTS + STORAGE
  • Pineapple, sea moss, lemon, honey and filtered water
  • Shake well before drinking
  • Keep refrigerated once opened
  • Best before date: see cap
BOTTLE + NUTRITION
  • 330ml bottle
  • Natural drink with sea moss
  • Sweetened with honey
  • Made with filtered water
  • Best before: see cap
FEATURES
  • Pineapple with sea moss
  • Tropical sweetness
  • Naturally sweetened with honey
  • 330ml bottle
  • Made with real ingredients
  • Shake before drinking
  • Serve chilled
